name: Alicia Edith
original_name: アリシア・イーディス
source: A Priest who is loved and respected by the people. He is referred to as a saint and is the most level-headed of the 3 heroes, but has a lust for money.
translation: A Priest who is loved and respected by the people. He is referred to as a saint and is the most level-headed of the 3 heroes, but has a lust for money.
